title: Umbuso lapho ukuphela kombusi kungabonakali khona
intro: Umlando uye wabazi ababusi bazo zonke izinhlobo, kodwa bambalwa ababephethe umbuso ofana nalo. Lapho umoya ngokwawo uphendula umyalo wabo futhi izisebenzi ezingabonakali zisebenza buthule, lo mbuso wawungafani nanoma yimuphi owangaphambili noma owangemva kwawo. Kodwa ngisho nemibuso emikhulu kumelwe iphele—futhi lapho lo uphela, iqiniso lavela emthonjeni othobekile kangangokuthi akekho owayecabanga ukusola.
clues: Nganikwa umbuso omkhulu yiNkosi yami, okukhulunywa ngawo emakhasini angcwele.
Ngazuza ukuhlakanipha negunya elikhulu kumzali owayehamba phambi kwami ​​ngokuzinikela.
Ngayala umoya uqobo, futhi wahamba ibanga elide ngenxa yezinhloso zami.
Izidalwa ezingabonakali emehlweni avamile zasebenza ngaphansi kwegunya lami, zakha izimangaliso ezingenakuqhathaniswa.
Imithombo yethusi elincibilikisiwe yageleza kimi, isibusiso esiyingqayizivele phakathi kwalabo abakhethwe ngu-Allah.
Lapho ngisuka kuleli zwe, umzimba wami waqhubeka umi uncike kudondolo. Kwaba yilapho isidalwa esincane somhlaba sidla kulolo dondolo lapho labo ababengizungezile baqaphela khona ukuthi sengidlulile.

arabic: فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَوْتَ مَا دَلَّهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَوْتِهِۦٓ إِلَّا دَآبَّةُ ٱلْأَرْضِ تَأْكُلُ مِنسَأَتَهُۥ ۖ فَلَمَّا خَرَّ تَبَيَّنَتِ ٱلْجِنُّ أَن لَّوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْغَيْبَ مَا لَبِثُوا۟ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
verse: And when We decreed for him [i.e., Solomon] death, nothing indicated to them [i.e., the jinn] his death except a creature of the earth eating his staff. But when he fell, it became clear to the jinn that if they had known the unseen, they would not have remained in humiliating punishment. (34:14)
